historical_coverage: CTIS became mandatory on 2023-01-31; earlier trials remain in national registries
known_limitations: ctis-public-api is the front end's own JSON API: public and unauthenticated but not a documented, versioned developer API, so response shapes may change without notice
the /search result rows omit publishDate; a /retrieve/{ctNumber} call per trial is required for the first-publication clock
decisionDate is a per-country free-text string; decisionDateOverall is the usable overall date
EU CT numbers are not linked to publications
licence: EU public information; no explicit per-record licence is published in the API payload
rate_limits: undocumented; we paced at 1.2s and kept page sizes at 2
research_value: The EU counterpart to ClinicalTrials.gov and the only public registry for trials under the Clinical Trials Regulation; essential for European device trials that never appear on CT.gov.
